items.title: Prologis Moves to Acquire Segro in $18.7B Mega Merger
items.summary: Prologis is moving to acquire Segro for $18.7B, potentially creating a major industrial merger and expanding its European presence.

items.title: British data centre owner set for £14bn US takeover

items.title: Segro’s board will back Prologis’ $18.7B takeover bid

items.title: Prologis Makes Final $18.7 Billion Bid to Take Over U.K.’s Segro
items.summary: Prologis—the world’s largest owner of industrial real estate—has made a 9.5% increase over its initial proposal to take over its smaller U.K. rival, ruling out further rises.
